quests.dispatcherQuestion: Days of heavy rain have caused a river to flood three towns along its route, cutting off one completely. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how help can reach a town the roads can't.
quests.explanation: An airlift is the only way to reach a town with every road route blocked by floodwater.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The other two towns still have road access but are running low on sandbags. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how supplies should reach towns still reachable by road.
quests.explanation: Trucks can reach these towns directly, so resources should go by the fastest available route.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Floodwaters have started to recede in all three towns after two days. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what phase of the response should now start.
quests.explanation: Starting clean-up as water recedes helps residents get back into their homes as quickly as it's safe to.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: An earthquake has caused a three-story apartment building to partially collapse with residents still trapped inside. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialist team trained for building collapses.
quests.explanation: Urban search and rescue teams are specifically trained to search collapsed structures safely for survivors.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Rescuers can hear tapping from beneath a section of fallen concrete on the second floor. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what specialist tool can help pinpoint the sound.
quests.explanation: Listening equipment helps rescuers locate a survivor precisely before deciding how to safely reach them.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman has been found alive and rescuers are carefully clearing debris around her. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must happen to the rubble before she is moved.
quests.explanation: Stabilizing the debris first prevents a second collapse while rescuers work to free her safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A freight train carrying industrial chemicals has derailed on the edge of a small town. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which residents should move first, given the danger.
quests.explanation: Evacuating the closest streets first protects the residents most at risk from any chemical leak or fire.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A hazmat team needs to identify exactly which chemicals are inside the derailed cars. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what document tells crews what's actually inside.
quests.explanation: The cargo manifest lists exactly what each car is carrying, letting the hazmat team plan safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The chemicals are confirmed non-toxic and crews begin the clean-up with standard precautions. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen now the chemicals are confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Lifting the order once the danger is ruled out lets residents return home without unnecessary delay.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A wildfire burning for two days has grown to threaten the edge of a small mountain town. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the strength of order needed at this stage.
quests.explanation: A mandatory order, rather than a suggestion, makes clear that leaving is not optional given the danger.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Some residents are refusing to leave their homes despite the mandatory order. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what direct action can persuade reluctant residents.
quests.explanation: A face-to-face visit from officers is often what finally convinces reluctant residents that the danger is real.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The wind has shifted, and firefighters confirm the town is no longer directly threatened. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what the evacuation order should become instead.
quests.explanation: Downgrading to a warning lets residents return while keeping them alert in case conditions change again.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional airport reports an incoming flight with a suspected landing gear fault and forty passengers aboard. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what safety measure should be laid down for landing.
quests.explanation: Foam on the runway reduces the risk of fire if the aircraft's gear fails on touchdown.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency crews position themselves along the runway before the aircraft's final approach. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be ready before the plane lands.
quests.explanation: Having every vehicle in position beforehand means crews can respond within seconds if anything goes wrong.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The aircraft has landed safely and all passengers are disembarking normally via the stairs. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what happens to the emergency crews now.
quests.explanation: Standing crews down once the landing is confirmed safe frees them for the airport's next call.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional blood bank reports a critical shortage after a series of serious road accidents overnight. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what public request should go out immediately.
quests.explanation: An urgent public appeal can bring in enough donors within hours to restock a critically low supply.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Donors are arriving faster than the small clinic can process them safely. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be added to handle the extra donors.
quests.explanation: A second site spreads the donors across two locations, letting staff process everyone safely and without long waits.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Both sites confirm the blood shortage has been fully resolved by evening. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the two things that should happen now the need is met.
quests.explanation: Thanking donors publicly and closing the extra sites brings a clear, positive end to the appeal.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A coastal town is bracing for a storm surge expected to overtop the sea wall within hours. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which part of town is most at risk.
quests.explanation: Streets closest to sea level are at greatest risk once the wall is overtopped, so they must leave first.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The town hall has been set up to shelter residents who cannot stay with family. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what public building should now be made available.
quests.explanation: Opening a formal shelter gives residents without other options a safe, warm place to wait out the storm.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The storm has passed out to sea without the surge reaching the predicted height. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen now the danger has passed.
quests.explanation: Allowing residents home once the danger is confirmed over ends the disruption as soon as it's genuinely safe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A chemical tanker has overturned on a rural highway, and the driver reports a slow leak. Input code!
quests.hint: Name the specialist team trained for this material risk.
quests.explanation: A hazmat team can safely assess and contain the leak without exposing themselves or the driver to more risk.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The hazmat team confirms the leaking chemical is flammable and needs a wide safety zone. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what boundary should be set up around the tanker.
quests.explanation: A clear perimeter keeps bystanders and other vehicles a safe distance from a flammable spill.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The leak has been fully contained and the tanker is ready to be righted and towed. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what final step reopens the road.
quests.explanation: Clearing the highway only after the leak is fully contained avoids any risk to the recovery crew.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large factory explosion has injured several workers and started a fire in the loading bay. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed given the scale of the explosion.
quests.explanation: An explosion of this size needs several engines to fight the fire while others help with the injured.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Paramedics need to sort several injured workers by how serious their injuries are. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the standard process for sorting multiple patients.
quests.explanation: Triage lets paramedics treat the most seriously hurt workers first, giving everyone the best chance of recovery.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All injured workers have been treated and the factory fire is fully extinguished. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what process should start once everyone is safe.
quests.explanation: An investigation afterward finds exactly what caused the explosion, helping prevent it from happening again.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A district power substation has failed, cutting electricity to a hospital, two care homes, and a school. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which building's power matters most, and why.
quests.explanation: The hospital's life-support equipment makes it the highest priority for power restoration among the affected buildings.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers can restore full power within the hour but need a temporary fix for the care homes now. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what temporary equipment can bridge the gap.
quests.explanation: Portable generators keep vulnerable care home residents safe and warm until the main power is restored.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the substation is repaired and full power is restored to all four buildings. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the temporary equipment now.
quests.explanation: Collecting the generators once real power returns frees them for the next emergency that may need them.
